Target: net9.0, win-x64, PE32+, AMD64, NativeAOT metadata 10.1
SDK: .NET SDK 9.0.316
Compiler: Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler 9.0.18, runtime.win-x64.microsoft.dotnet.ilcompiler 9.0.18
Linker: MSVC 14.44.35207 Hostx64\x64\link.exe
Runtime source tag: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/tree/v9.0.18
Managed calling convention: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/runtime/v9.0.18/docs/design/coreclr/botr/clr-abi.md
NativeFormat TypeDefinition record: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/runtime/v9.0.18/src/coreclr/tools/Common/Internal/Metadata/NativeFormat/NativeFormatReaderGen.cs, members Flags, BaseType, NamespaceDefinition, Name, Size, PackingSize, EnclosingType, NestedTypes, Methods, Fields, Properties, Events, GenericParameters, Interfaces, CustomAttributes
NativeFormat Field record: same file, members Flags, Name, Signature, DefaultValue, Offset, CustomAttributes
NativeFormat FieldSignature record: same file, single member Type, one of TypeDefinition, TypeReference, TypeSpecification, ModifiedType
NativeFormat record order is identical at tags v7.0.20, v8.0.14, v9.0.18 and v10.0.0-preview.7.25380.108 for all three records
ECMA-335 field attributes: ECMA-335 6th edition, II.23.1.5 FieldAttributes, Static 0x0010 and Literal 0x0040 exclude a field from the instance layout
ECMA-335 type layout: ECMA-335 6th edition, II.23.1.15 TypeAttributes, LayoutMask 0x00000018 and SequentialLayout 0x00000008
Microsoft x64 argument registers: RCX, RDX, R8, R9 for integer and pointer arguments
Microsoft x64 hidden struct return: a return value larger than eight bytes is written through a caller-supplied pointer passed in RCX, which shifts every declared argument to the next position, so a declared argument at position N binds the register of physical position N plus one
Microsoft x64 register-returned struct: a struct of one, two, four or eight bytes is returned in RAX with no hidden pointer
Convention low nibble on this image: 0x0 for static methods and 0x0 plus HASTHIS for instance methods and constructors
Reflection rooting: each probe struct is named in a direct typeof(T).GetFields call so ILCompiler keeps its Field records; without that call the field metadata is trimmed and the field names are absent from the image
Command: dotnet publish managed_abi_sret_net9_x86_64.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o publish
Build directory: the project, Program.cs and publish output live outside the repository; PathMap rewrites the project directory to C:\src\managed_abi_sret_net9_x86_64 so no build path is embedded
Path leak scan: the committed image carries zero occurrences of the byte sequence C:\ in ASCII and in UTF-16LE
